title: enhanced-uninstall on a config.vdf with an unbalanced '}': legacy logs python-vdf's SyntaxError text ('vdf.parse: one too many closing parenthasis (config.vdf, line 1)'), the port logs its own wording
culprit: steam/vdf.rs ParseError texts (+ callers in enhanced/linux.rs)
suggested_fix: use python-vdf's messages `vdf.parse: <msg> (<file name>, line <n>)` (messages: 'one too many closing parenthasis', 'unclosed parenthasis or quotes (EOF)', 'expected openning bracket', 'unexpected EOF (open quote for value?)', 'unexpected EOF (open key quote?)')
notes: the sentence ' The earliest copy PatchOpsIII saw is kept at <path>.' the port appends is a known intentional addition and is normalised away by difffuzz TEXT_NORMALISERS
